podcast.body: Released in 1999, this album showcased Sting's continued genre dabbling, notably including a collaboration with Algerian Rai singer Cheb Mami on the song "Desert Rose." The album entered the top 10 for the first time after "Desert Rose" gained popularity and eventually went double platinum. "On his 1999 album Brand New Day, Sting included a collaboration with Algerian singer Cheb Mami, a vocalist of the Arabic folk music known as Rai."

podcast.body: This album became Sting's biggest-selling solo record ever after his song "Desert Rose" was licensed for a Jaguar commercial. The commercial provided significant exposure for the song, which had previously been ignored by radio, directly boosting the album's sales and overall success.
